data.name: Ectoplasmic Form
data.description: You can transform into a cloud of ectoplasm. Treat this as gaseous form, except that you can fly at a speed of 30 feet, and you can solidify your form sufficiently to carry small objects, though fine manipulation is impossible. You can use this ability for %1 minutes per day. These minutes need not be consecutive, but must be used in 1-minute increments.|Sorcerer_EctoplasmEctoplasmicForm_Duration
